cards.verse_text: After forty days Noah opened the window he had made in the ark and sent out a raven.
cards.snippet: …the window he had made in the ark and sent out a raven.

cards.card_text: The raven Noah sends out keeps flying back and forth until the waters dry up.
Then God lists the birds they must not eat: the eagle, vultures, falcons, ravens and FIVE kinds of owl.
cards.verse_text: Additionally, you are to detest the following birds, and they must not be eaten because they are detestable: the eagle, the bearded vulture, the black vulture, the kite, any kind of falcon, any kind of raven, the ostrich, the screech owl, the gull, any kind of hawk, the little owl, the cormorant, the great owl, the white owl, the desert owl, the osprey, the stork, any kind of heron, the hoopoe, and the bat.

cards.card_text: Then the birds: any clean bird is fine, but Moses lists the ones that aren't, from the eagle and the raven all the way to the bat.
cards.verse_text: You may eat any clean bird, but these you may not eat: the eagle, the bearded vulture, the black vulture, the red kite, the falcon, any kind of kite, any kind of raven, the ostrich, the screech owl, the gull, any kind of hawk, the little owl, the great owl, the white owl, the desert owl, the osprey, the cormorant, the stork, any kind of heron, the hoopoe, or the bat.

cards.verse_text: And you are to drink from the brook, and I have commanded the ravens to feed you there.”
cards.snippet: …you are to drink from the brook, and I have commanded the ravens to feed you there.”

cards.card_text: Then here come the ravens, flying in like room service with WINGS.
cards.verse_text: The ravens would bring him bread and meat in the morning and evening, and he would drink from the brook.

cards.card_text: From the lions, the LORD goes to a bird: the raven.
cards.verse_text: Who provides food for the raven when its young cry out to God as they wander about for lack of food?

cards.verse_text: He provides food for the animals, and for the young ravens when they call.
cards.snippet: He provides food for the animals, and for the young ravens when they call.

cards.card_text: May the ravens of the valley pluck it out May the lions of the field tear it apart May the jackals of the desert eat it up
cards.verse_text: As for the eye that mocks a father and scorns obedience to a mother, may the ravens of the valley pluck it out and young vultures devour it.
cards.snippet: …that mocks a father and scorns obedience to a mother, may the ravens of the valley pluck it out and young vultures devour it.

cards.card_text: His head is purest gold, his hair is black as a raven, and his eyes are like doves beside the streams of water.
cards.verse_text: His head is purest gold; his hair is wavy and black as a raven.
cards.snippet: …head is purest gold; his hair is wavy and black as a raven.

cards.verse_text: The desert owl and screech owl will possess it, and the great owl and raven will dwell in it.
cards.snippet: …owl and screech owl will possess it, and the great owl and raven will dwell in it.
